title: limonium beaumierianum var. annuum
intro: Limonium beaumierianum var. annuum, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and possessing antimicrobial properties that can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds.
